WITH transaction_customer_link AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.transaction_amount,
    c.state_county_province
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Invoices i ON ft.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    SUM(transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM transaction_customer_link
  GROUP BY state_county_province
),
grand_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_total) as all_states_total
  FROM state_totals
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.state_total,
    st.state_total / gt.all_states_total as state_share
  FROM state_totals st
  CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(state_share) as avg_share
  FROM state_shares
),
above_average_states AS (
  SELECT 
    ss.state_total,
    ss.state_share
  FROM state_shares ss
  CROSS JOIN average_share avg_s
  WHERE ss.state_share > avg_s.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(state_total) as combined_transaction_total,
  AVG(state_share) as average_share_of_above_average_states,
  AVG(state_share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share) as average_excess_share
FROM above_average_states
